HxResult HxRadioButtonDelete ( HxRadioButton_t *  pRadioButton  ) 

Delete a radio button widget.

This function deletes a radio button created from an earlier call to HxRadioButtonNew. Deleting the last radio button in a group sets the group to NULL.

It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application, since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is deleted. HxRadioButtonDelete only needs to be called when removing a radio button at runtime.

Parameters:
pRadioButton IN: Pointer to the radio button to delete
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxRadioButtonGetSelected ( HxRadioGroup_t *  pGroup,
HxRadioButton_t **  hRadioButton 
)

Get the radio button that is on.

This function returns the radio button in a group whose state is set to kHxRadioButtonOn. Note that only one, but always one, radio button in a group is on.

Parameters:
pGroup IN: Pointer to a radio button group
hRadioButton OUT: Returns the radio button that is on
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if no radio button is on.

HxResult HxRadioButtonNew ( uint32_t  id,
HxWidget_t *  pParent,
const char *  pText,
int32_t  x,
int32_t  y,
HxRadioButton_t **  hRadioButton,
HxRadioGroup_t **  hGroup 
)

Create a radio button control widget.

This function creates a new radio button control widget.

The hGroup argument is a handle to an opaque data structure used by the system to associate related radio buttons. When creating the first radio button in a group, the application must set *hGroup to NULL. Thereafter, as additional radio buttons are added to the group, the same hGroup argument must be used.

Parameters:
id IN: Unique ID for the widget, defined by app, or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
pParent IN: Pointer to "parent" widget containing button
pText IN: Text for the button label, or NULL
x IN: x coordinate for the top left button origin
y IN: y coordinate for the top left button origin
hRadioButton OUT: Handle to the new radio button; *hRadioButton is NULL on failure
hGroup IN/OUT: Handle to the radio button group
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails, and sets *hRadioButton to NULL.
